directives.title: Challenge £12.7K paid during active Companies House breaches
directives.evidence: 3 suppliers received payments while in breach of Companies Act — including 0 critical and 0 high severity. Temporally verified against payment dates.
directives.notes: Due-diligence control failure. Request supplier screening process review.

directives.title: Challenge £41.5M suspected split payments
directives.evidence: 151 instances of 3+ payments just below approval thresholds in the same week
directives.notes: Classic indicator of bypassed procurement controls. FOI procurement authorisation records.

directives.title: FOI: round-number payments over £5K (£49.6M)
directives.evidence: 1203 exact round-number payments over £5,000 — may indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts
directives.notes: Round figures can indicate estimates rather than invoiced amounts. FOI invoice breakdown for top 20.

directives.title: Question 1.9x March year-end spending spike
directives.evidence: Adult and Health Services spent 1.9x their monthly average in March (£24.8M above normal). Note: UK councils operate on April–March fiscal years, so elevated March spending is common as departments finalise annual budgets. Spikes above 3x warrant further scrutiny.
directives.notes: Request written explanation from s151 officer. Compare with peer pattern.

directives.title: Review 15 rapid-payment suppliers (<14-day cadence)
directives.evidence: 15 suppliers receive payments every <14 days on average. Top: Reed Specialist Recruitment Limited. (2.1 day avg, 20 payments, £38.5K)
directives.notes: Suggests framework contract lacking consolidation OR pass-through arrangement. Request contract register for top 5.

directives.title: Review Benford's Law first-digit distribution (3.8% dev)
directives.evidence: Digit distribution across 119,209 transactions shows χ²=4607.93 (statistically significant due to large sample size), but max digit deviation is only 3.8% — within the normal range for UK council spending patterns. No practical evidence of fabricated invoices.
directives.notes: Statistical noise on large samples; compare with other councils before escalating.

directives.title: Investigate Benford's 2nd-digit anomaly (χ²=2199.2)
directives.evidence: Second-digit distribution across 119,209 transactions shows p < 0.001 (highly significant). Digit 0 deviates 4.18% from Nigrini's expected distribution. Second-digit tests are more discriminating than first-digit for detecting round-number bias and fabricated invoices.
directives.notes: Second-digit tests are more discriminating than first-digit for round-number bias and fabricated invoices.

directives.title: Scrutinise 65 weak-competition contracts
directives.evidence: 65 contracts show signs of limited competition (short tender periods or rapid award). Top: GB-Durham: TPPL Durham County Council NEPO HGV lot (£3.7M)
directives.notes: FOI tender evaluation reports. Question at Scrutiny why restricted tender was used.

directives.title: Request internal audit action plan on all 8 DOGE findings
directives.notes: Formal letter to Chief Internal Auditor requesting a written action plan covering all DOGE findings. Request named owners, committed timescales, and reporting back to Audit Committee.
